caption:
You handle sales, delivery, and invoicing alone. Branding and finance reports usually eat your afternoon. The new Gemini Business Hub sits inside the Gemini app and connects to Shopify, Canva, and Google Workspace. Upload your brand guidelines once and it generates consistent visuals automatically. Paste your sales spreadsheet and it returns clear money reports without manual formatting.

Copy this prompt into the Gemini chat:
Upload my brand guidelines and connect my Shopify and Canva accounts. 

This works for any freelancer or solo operator using the Gemini mobile or desktop app. The feature rolls out globally in the coming days for all app users. 

Save this post for your next admin block. Share it with a fellow solo operator who dreads spreadsheet work.

Follow @leverageai.daily — one AI workflow a day for people who run their own business.
